session.title: Church 3.5 km fun run and telematch
session.purpose: Participate fully in the church event while containing unfamiliar eccentric running, acceleration, lateral-movement, and heat stress.

dose.planning_duration: Approximately 90-150 minutes including games; actual church schedule governs.
dose.warm_up: 5-10 minutes progressive walking and easy jogging plus ankle, calf, hip, and lateral-movement preparation.
dose.run: 3.5 km at social/conversational effort, RPE 3-5; not a time trial.
dose.telematch: Games are the day's variable-intensity exposure. Build into accelerations rather than using maximal first efforts.
dose.completion: The church event is the entire training dose; no MTB, trainer, gym, or make-up session afterward.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A controlled social run and games provide useful locomotor variety and coordination without excessive soreness when intensity is contained and novelty is respected.
execution_rules: Use secure footwear and inspect wet or slippery grass before faster running or direction changes.
Keep the 3.5 km social; save no fitness test for the finish.
Treat telematch sprinting, jumping, and lateral cuts as the high-variable load even if Garmin underestimates it.
No additional planned exercise after the event.

expected_result.event: Comfortable completion with good coordination and no escalating calf, Achilles, knee, or adductor symptoms.
expected_result.garmin_load: Variable and not a target to chase.
expected_result.next_day: Sunday Sabbath with only mild, non-limiting novelty soreness.

stop_rules: Do not race the run if same-day readiness is red, sleep is poor with weak feel, or illness symptoms are present.
Stop or walk for sharp or escalating calf, Achilles, knee, hamstring, or adductor pain; limping; loss of coordination; dizziness; confusion; chills; or heat-illness symptoms.
Downshift games when the surface is slick, footing is uncertain, or repeated accelerations degrade movement quality.
A triggered stop rule ends or downshifts the relevant event; do not compensate afterward.
